notes.title: 0.3.0 Patch notes
notes.content:
The 0.3.0 patch update for INUMEDA was released today.

Update Details

◆ New Command Added to Battle System
During battle, 'Miko' (shrine maidens) can now 'Summon' animal allies by consuming 'MP'.
A key feature of the newly added 'MP' parameter is that it replenishes each time an ally falls.
(It recovers based on the number of 'Imperial Stars' of the fallen ally.)
To use 'Summon,' players must progress in the game to a certain point and examine the sacred pillars.
Use 'Summon' strategically to enhance combat strength and avoid total annihilation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44484128/3a076a5027504f22f1dc784aefb0a487371afec0.png

◆ Additional Stele (Notice Board) Texts
To facilitate a better understanding of the game's world and system, new 'Stele (Notice Boards)' have been placed around the world.
They contain important information for progressing in the game.
Discover more about the world of INUMEDA through these Steles. Key information will be recorded in the 'Journal' and can be accessed from the menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44484128/1da29084e4b126e0fe8431fdf7e60a0f739ecc9d.png

◆ Adjusted Enemy Encounters
Particularly in the early game maps, the enemy encounter areas have been adjusted.
This update makes the world of INUMEDA more enjoyable, so if you haven't played yet, now is a great time to purchase INUMEDA.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44484128/afd1183c776706e9120e317c5a2089e5ab51f70b.png

◆ Resources and Battle System Updates

 Addition of skill effects during battles.
 Addition and modification of sound effects.
 Implementation of a loop enhancement system for boss characters.


◆ Other Updates

 Additionally, made minor bug fixes and balanced adjustments.

notes.title: 0.2.0 Patch notes and a price increase.
notes.content:
Today, we are pleased to announce the 0.2.0 patch update and price adjustment for 'INUMEDA'.
〇Update Details

◆Controls Update

You can now navigate the game using the keyboard.
*For detailed instructions, refer to the "Controller Guide."


◆Visual Updates

 Modified the formation of accompanying allies from a single line to a maximum of three columns.
 Added effects during combat.
 Introduced graphics for the protagonist's weapon displayed during battles.
 Changed the visual representation when a companion falls in battle due to death.
 Adjusted map shapes.


◆Functionality Updates

 Added a menu to review combo details.
This allows checking skill effects and activation conditions.
 Modified the item menu to enable confirmation of equipped items.
 Updated the shop menu to display the quantity of the selected item.
 When selecting an equipment item, now displays the status difference compared to the currently equipped item.
 Changed the ability to toggle battle message playback speed with a single button press.


◆Other Updates


 Adjusted encounter rates.
 Changed the respawn location upon total party defeat.
 Balanced some enemies.
 Addressed minor bug fixes.


〇About the Price Increase
This time marks our first update that goes beyond bug fixes. We've added elements to enhance your gaming experience, including improved graphics. To ensure you can enjoy the game even more comfortably, we've adjusted the selling price, effective from the update on November 29th. Hope you'll love the improvements.


3.75 USD ⇒ 7.99 USD
*Prices may vary by country, so please refer to the store page for detailed information.
 Also, this change will not affect those who have already purchased the game.


Moving forward, we plan to incorporate feedback and continue updating. 
We appreciate your ongoing support for 'INUMEDA.'
